sheet: Use case: stylized-concept. Production transparent animation sprite sheet for an original fantasy tactical RPG crossbow mercenary. Reference image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: match its restrained warm dark-brown ink and flat cel colors, NOT its ragged bandit identity or club. Create a lean adult male mercenary with plain squared iron helmet, exposed serious face, squared rust-brown plated shoulder armor and short armored tunic, charcoal trousers, dark boots, leather bolt quiver at hip, a clearly recognizable single wooden crossbow with transverse steel bow. Natural adult proportions. Mercenary must look armored and square, distinct from ragged bandits. Exact same face, helmet, costume and single weapon in every pose. Three-quarter view slightly above, all facing SCREEN-RIGHT. EXACTLY NINE isolated full-body poses in regular THREE-COLUMN THREE-ROW grid, canvas1536x2304 preferred. Every cell equal512x768 with wide transparent gutters, complete body and crossbow inside each cell. Same scale across cells, kneeling pose shorter not enlarged. Row1: idleA holding crossbow low across waist with right trigger hand and left hand supporting stock; idleB breath with same feet; walkA near leg forward and far leg back, crossbow held safely across torso. Row2: walkB far leg forward and near leg back, visibly opposite contact; cast0 raising crossbow to shoulder and aiming screen-right, both feet planted; cast1 firing crossbow level screen-right, right hand trigger grip, left hand supports fore-end, slight recoil. Row3: cast2 lowering crossbow to recover; hit0 recoiling shoulders backward retaining weapon; ko0 on one knee head bowed, crossbow lowered across raised knee. No blood. Crossbow retains coherent stock, bow, string, trigger grip and orientation, never becomes rifle/bow/sword. Hands anatomically coherent four fingers and thumb, no fused wrists. Flat two-tone material fills, clean readable silhouette at40pixels, minimal small detailing, no gradients or texture. GENUINE ALPHA TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND, no checkerboard, ground shadow, glow, text, cell labels, borders, effects, scenery or separate flying bolt. Entire subject confined within own cell with60pixel margins.
walkCorrection: Edit target: supplied transparent 3x3 crossbow mercenary sprite sheet. Change ONLY ROW2 COLUMN1 walking figure. It currently repeats row1 column3 leg contact. Make the near anatomical LEFT leg (the leg on image LEFT in idle, closer to viewer, under visible hip bolt quiver) step FORWARD toward screen-right and plant. Its boot and knee must be in front, while anatomical RIGHT far leg trails screen-left with heel raised. Visibly exchange which leg leads, not simply move the same pose. Keep crossbow steady, natural same two-hand grip. All other eight cells unchanged. Preserve SAME figure scale, helmet, face, armor, boot cuffs, charcoal trousers, weapon, regular3x3 layout and all margins. Preserve genuine alpha transparency. No background, shadow, glow, letters, labels or effects.
portrait: Use case: identity-preserve. Create one square1024x1024 illustrated bust portrait of the EXACT original crossbow mercenary in provided sprite sheet (character identity reference). Same lean adult male, angular serious clean-shaven face, warm medium skin, plain squared iron helmet with central seam and cheek guards, rust-brown squared plated pauldrons and armored tunic, cream undersleeves, dark leather gloves. Three-quarter facing screen-right, calm watchful expression. Head and shoulders centered with generous crown margin for circular HUD crop; crossbow upper stock and transverse steel bow subtly visible at lower chest edge, held coherently in both hands, without obscuring face. Clean dark-brown ink, two flat tones per material, no textures/hatching/gradient or glow. Flat uniform warm parchment #f4e9d8 background. No text, symbols, badges, scenery, border or known character likeness.
